name: The Mind's Eye
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Kin'weelay seeks The Mind's Eye to save Yenniku. Mai'Zoth holds the gem deep in the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.

sections.title: A Powerful Gem
sections.body: After the singing crystals are recovered, Kin'weelay turns to The Mind's Eye. He believes only the gem can help save Yenniku, son of the Darkspear chieftain. Mai'Zoth holds it. Kin'weelay remembers the ogre mage from the Darkspear tribe's earlier days in the jungle.

sections.title: The Depths of Mosh'Ogg
sections.body: Mai'Zoth dwells deep in the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound, east of Grom'gol. His magic was formidable before he took The Mind's Eye, and the stone has made him stronger still. The ogre stronghold is perilous. Yet the gem is the young troll's only hope of freedom.

sections.title: Into the Nether
sections.body: Mai'Zoth's defeat casts the ogre mage from the realm of flesh and bone into the Nether, Kin'weelay says. His physical threat has ended, but Kin'weelay quietly fears Mai'Zoth may build a new dominion in the spirit world. For now, those worries can wait. The witch doctor prepares the ritual to save Yenniku.

faq.answer: Mai'Zoth holds The Mind's Eye deep inside the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound, east of Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: Why does Kin'weelay need the Mind's Eye?
aliases: why do we need minds eye
faq.answer: Kin'weelay needs The Mind's Eye for a ritual he believes is the only way to save Yenniku, the lost son of the Darkspear chief.

faq.q: Where does this stand in the search for Yenniku?
aliases: what quest comes before the minds eye
faq.answer: The search follows The Singing Crystals. Securing The Mind's Eye opens the way to Saving Yenniku.
Mai'Zoth is an ogre mage Kin'weelay knew from the time the Darkspear trolls lived in the jungle. His formidable magic grew stronger with The Mind's Eye.

angles.text: As a troll, you need The Mind's Eye to help free Yenniku, son of the Darkspear chieftain.
As a member of the Horde, you help the Darkspear trolls strike at the Mosh'Ogg stronghold from Grom'gol Base Camp.
